name: Vorelo — Two-Way Job Board
author: matchworkhq

sections.description:
Vorelo is a complete, two-way job board for WordPress. Unlike most job board plugins, both sides are first-class: employers post jobs and can proactively contact candidates, while candidates publish a profile and apply to jobs. It works out of the box — no extra add-ons to buy and no WooCommerce to configure.

Why Vorelo

  • Two-way matching — employers reach out to candidates and candidates apply to jobs. Bidirectional contact is included for free.
  • All-in-one — job listings, candidate profiles, applications, CV upload, expiry management and essential email notifications in a single plugin.
  • Ready in minutes — pages are created automatically on activation, with roles and taxonomies pre-configured.
  • Ready-made taxonomy terms — start with generic roles, contracts and shifts, then add terms for your industry.
  • Privacy-first — contact details stay hidden until an application is accepted; built-in account deletion for GDPR.

Core features (free)

  • Job listings and candidate profiles with search and filters (city, role, contract type, shifts)
  • Bidirectional applications with statuses (sent, seen, accepted, rejected)
  • CV upload and secure, permission-based download
  • Registration and role activation for candidates and employers
  • Candidate and employer dashboards
  • Essential email notifications
  • Basic platform statistics, including traffic and conversion (admin)
  • Generic roles, contracts and shifts seeded on activation

Pro

  • Editable email templates and additional notification workflows
  • Automatic expiry reminders
  • Job duplication and advanced copy controls

Enterprise

  • Agency workspace and Matchboard — run the site as a recruitment agency from a dedicated frontend workspace: internal shortlists that stay invisible until you propose, recruiter assignments, notes, follow-ups, candidate-centric views, bulk proposal tools, agency-branded proposal emails with single-use, scanner-safe CV download links, and full pipeline tracking (shortlist → proposed → interview → offered → placed)
  • Agency-only mode — optionally disable direct applications so every match goes through the agency
  • Analytics and agency reports — KPI cards, conversion funnel, time-to-fill trend, top clients, loss reasons, 30-day views trend, top jobs and candidates

Enterprise (1.7.0)

  • REST API v1 — read and write endpoints for jobs, candidates and applications with capability-scoped auth and a mtwk_rest_rate_limit filter for site-level throttling
  • Outgoing webhooks — signed application and registration events with per-endpoint secret and delivery retries
  • In-app notifications — bell icon on candidate/employer/agency dashboards, mark-as-read UI, per-role event routing

Enterprise roadmap (not yet shipped)

CSV import/export, multisite and white-label are on the roadmap for a future release. They are not available today.

Upgrades are handled securely through Freemius (Merchant of Record), which manages billing, invoicing and EU VAT.

Vorelo bundles Choices.js 10.2.0 under the MIT license for accessible multi-select fields. The preferred source and build instructions are available at https://github.com/Choices-js/Choices/tree/v10.2.0.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/vorelo-job-board directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen. All required pages are created automatically.
  3. Go to Vorelo → Settings to optionally set your Privacy Policy URL. Add industry-specific taxonomy terms in the admin as needed.
  4. Share the “Choose your path” page so candidates and employers can register.
sections.faq:
Is it really two-way?

Yes. Candidates apply to jobs, and employers can also send contact proposals directly to candidates. Bidirectional contact is available on the free version.

Do I need WooCommerce or any add-on?

No. Vorelo works on its own — no add-ons and no WooCommerce required.

Are contact details public?

No. A candidate’s email and phone become visible to an employer only after the application (or proposal) has been accepted, and vice versa. When the site owner uses the Enterprise Agency Matchboard to explicitly propose a candidate, the CV can be shared through a single-use, time-limited download link so the employer can review the profile before deciding — every access is audit-logged.

Can I use it for a specific industry?

Yes. Generic roles, contract types and shifts are seeded on activation. Add or edit terms from the admin for your industry.

Does it send any data to the developer?

No. The version published on WordPress.org bundles no licensing or telemetry SDK and sends no data off your site. For its own features it stores some data locally in your WordPress database — for example job and profile view counts and CV download access logs — which never leaves your server. The separate commercial Pro and Enterprise editions use Freemius (Merchant of Record) for licensing, updates and billing, where any usage-data collection is strictly opt-in.
sections.changelog:
1.7.0

  • Compliance: core jobs and taxonomies are unrestricted, CV security is included in every edition, public branding is not forced, and CSS overrides use WordPress Additional CSS instead of a plugin code editor
  • Enterprise: REST API v1 — jobs, candidates and applications read/write endpoints with capability-scoped auth, per-page and pagination headers, direction-aware create/accept/reject flows and a mtwk_rest_rate_limit filter for third-party throttling
  • Enterprise: outgoing webhooks — settings tab to register endpoints per event, HMAC-signed payloads with per-endpoint secret, delivery retries and a manual test action
  • Pro and Enterprise: in-app notifications — bell icon on candidate, employer and agency dashboards with unread badge, mark-as-read, click-through to the linked application
  • Agency workspace: match archive/restore append-only in activity timeline; withdrawal reason retained privately; reopened matches clear participant rejection state cleanly; company-managed jobs surface direct-flow visibility
  • Agency workspace: cosmetic reorganisation of the job board — Selection-in-progress and Shortlist blocks in matching section panels with inline archive filter and count pills
  • i18n: complete gettext coverage, ready for community translations and language packs through translate.wordpress.org
  • Diagnostic tooling: tools/pre-beta-checks.php runs 181 assertions covering CPT/taxonomy registration, admin_post handler wiring, is_targetable() truth matrix and a regression harness (mtwk_pb_known_bug()) for open bugs
  • Security tooling: tools/pre-release-security.php runs 46 static + runtime checks (nonce on every state-changing handler, superglobal sanitisation, prepared SQL, upload MIME/size/rename, XSS in templates, REST rate-limit filter presence)
  • Fix: MTWK_Helpers::format_datetime() no longer emits year -0001 for MySQL zero-date sentinels

1.6.0

  • Enterprise: agency reports in the frontend workspace — KPI cards, conversion funnel, time-to-fill trend, top clients and loss-reason breakdown
  • Enterprise: candidate-centric agency view showing all matches for one candidate, stage timelines and double-submission warnings
  • Enterprise: bulk propose for shortlisted candidates with per-record capability checks and capped batch size
  • Enterprise: follow-up dates on notes with overdue surfacing in the workspace
  • Enterprise: workspace styling now honours the Appearance settings (fonts, radius, density, content width, shadows and accent buttons)
  • Privacy: agency pipeline stages remain internal to the agency workflow and are not exposed in candidate/employer dashboards
  • Settings: export/import Vorelo settings as JSON, with sanitised merge or replace import modes
  • Search: indexed keyword search now covers title, content, employer/company names and taxonomy terms

1.5.0

  • Enterprise: Agency workspace — new dedicated frontend area at /matchwork-agency/ so Agency Managers and Recruiters can work outside wp-admin. Tabs for Overview (my open matches, recently updated, team pipeline for managers), Jobs (per-job matchboard with shortlist/propose/reassign/notes/withdrawal forms), Candidates and Team (manager only)
  • Enterprise: dedicated roles Agency Manager and Recruiter with granular capabilities (mtwk_access_matchboard, mtwk_manage_all_matches, mtwk_manage_assigned_matches, mtwk_manage_recruiters, mtwk_view_candidate_cvs, mtwk_view_agency_reports). Matchboard authorization no longer relies on manage_options
  • Enterprise: per-record assignment model — every agency application has a responsible recruiter (auto-assigned on shortlist, reassignable by managers), and Recruiters see only records assigned to them
  • Enterprise: assignment history on each match plus an “Assigned to me” quick filter for managers
  • Enterprise: Agency Manager can invite recruiters by email from the Team tab; invited users receive the native WordPress password-setup email and land on the workspace after first login
  • Enterprise: Recruiter role loses the WordPress admin bar and is redirected out of wp-admin (with whitelist for admin-post.php, admin-ajax.php, async-upload.php, profile.php, user-edit.php)
  • Architecture: Matchboard split into a query layer (MTWK_Matchboard_Query), a state-transition service (MTWK_Matchboard_Service) and thin wp-admin handlers, so the same business logic backs the wp-admin Matchboard and the frontend workspace without duplication
  • Upgrade safety: agency roles and the workspace page are idempotently synced on init, so an install that never re-fires activation picks them up on the next request

1.3.0

  • Enterprise: Agency Matchboard — job-centric matching board with internal shortlists, pipeline stages, per-match notes and withdrawal reasons
  • Enterprise: agency-branded proposal emails with scanner-safe, single-use CV download links (7-day expiry, audit-logged) so employers can review candidates before accepting
  • Enterprise: agency-only mode to route every match through the agency
  • Pro: duplicate a job listing into an editable draft
  • Security: CV storage uses a private, randomised path below wp-content/uploads/matchwork/ — files are never referenced by any URL WordPress emits; Apache sites keep the .htaccess safeguard, Nginx sites must block direct requests to that path. Upgraders auto-migrate on activation
  • Security: hardened application snapshot loading (reject cross-candidate id mixing); detail pages reject draft/trashed/expired/disabled posts to non-owners
  • Security: direct apply and direct contact handlers validate target is published, active and owned; CV file is cleaned up when a candidate profile is deleted
  • Fix: fallback pricing/upgrade page so upsell links no longer land on a permission error
  • Fix: Free taxonomy cap raised from 5 to 8 so activation seed does not exceed the limit

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
